        }
        memo.put(key, result);
        return result;

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        long num = scan.nextLong();
        int tam = (int)(Math.log10(Math.abs(num))) + 1;
        System.out.println("" + compute(num, tam));
    }

    private static long repunit(int k) {
        return (long)(Math.pow(10, k) - 1) / 9;
    }

    private static long compute(long n, int d) {
        long r = repunit(1 + d);
        long q = n / r;
        long rem = n % r;
        long base = q * (1 + d);
        if (rem == 0) return base;
        long option1 = (1 + d) + compute(r - rem, d - 1);
        long option2 = compute(rem, d - 1);
        return base + (option1 < option2 ? option1 : option2);
    }
}
